dataset: Crop22 to FAO EcoCrop candidate crosswalk
status: Research-derived subset; ecological requirements, not controlled physiological tolerance trials

license.attribution: Source data: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), ECOCROP. Accessed 29 October 2026. CC BY 4.0. CSV snapshot distributed by OpenCLIM, commit ea43ecd418fd1a1ea08d32c7dce64b7fae02dec4. This candidate crosswalk, field renaming, null conversion and selected records are derived modifications; no FAO endorsement.

provenance.note: Database discontinued around 2015 according to FAO; current catalogue date is not a new experimental dataset version.

salinity_class_definitions.none: Original qualitative class; no quantified bound established here
salinity_class_definitions.null: No data, NOT zero salinity and NOT tolerant

excluded_inference: Do not treat absolute ecological range as lethal physiological boundary.
Do not equate Phoenix diluted WCL EC to soil saturated-paste extract ECe.
Do not interpolate a salinity-yield curve from categorical salinity classes.
No averaging across ambiguous species; preserve selected taxon and provenance.
